Annual electricity statement issued by Quillhaven Power Co-operative, the electricity supplier, to its member M. Venn (Marisol Venn), who shared it with Fernhollow Solar.
Member: M. Venn.
Statement period: 1 September 2025 to 31 August 2026.
Tariff: Night Owl two-rate.
Night rate applies from 00:30 to 05:30 every day. Day rate applies at all other times.
Night rate: 9 pence per kilowatt-hour. Day rate: 31 pence per kilowatt-hour.
Total consumption for the period: 3,150 kilowatt-hours.
Of which night rate: 410 kilowatt-hours.
Of which day rate: 2,740 kilowatt-hours.
Supply type: single phase.
Main fuse rating: 80 amps.
Export meter fitted: no.
